Subject: Centralized demo block — cohort + split-runway coordination

Hi all —

Thanks again for your interest in Redwood. Rather than scheduling separate one-off demos for each of you this week, weve found that a short shared cohort demo followed by optional 1:1 office-hours slots is faster and more useful for teams evaluating infra/perf.

Proposal (45 + 15 model):
- 45-minute cohort demo: product overview, performance highlights (latency/cost examples), brief Q&A
- 15-minute optional 1:1 office-hours immediately after for deep-dive/procurement questions

Candidate blocks (all US times):
- Tue Jul 26: 11:00am-12:00pm ET
- Wed Jul 27: 2:00pm-3:00pm ET
- Thu Jul 28: 4:30pm-5:30pm ET

If you see a slot that works, reply with your preferred block or use the Calendly link below to pick a time. Ill send an updated calendar invite and the cohort deck (attached) once we lock a slot.

Attachments: redwood-cohort-demo-deck-v2.pdf, central-demo-block.ics
Links: https://calendly.com/redwood/cohort-demo-block-45

Thanks — looking forward to hosting a short consolidated session and then pairing 1:1 where useful.

Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
